svg.title: Prepare the staircase states
svg.desc: Four prepared fictional components show an original staircase sketch in Gallery, Study detail, Kept for later and Saved items, including controls for opening and keeping it. These are author-prepared responses to possible actions, not participant instructions, observed behavior or evidence of successful usability testing.

g.text: Keep this staircase sketch so you can return to it tomorrow.
Show a prepared state only after their chosen action.
